page.content:
Anxious clownfish father who crosses the ocean.

How Marlin connects

  • Work: Finding Nemo — Finding Nemo is Marlin's ocean search.
  • Faction: Clownfish family — Marlin is the father of the clownfish family.
  • Character: Dory — Dory keeps Marlin moving across the ocean.

What is Marlin?

Marlin is Nemo's father, overprotective after a barracuda raid, who has to trust the reef — and Dory — to get his son back.

Key threads lead to Finding Nemo, Clownfish family and Dory.
